dct_description_sm: Changes in tree regeneration at northern treelines will have a great impact on future treeline dynamics (expansion, contraction, etc).  Recent findings suggest that tree responses to climate change may vary across sub-Arctic and Arctic tree stands.  The specific limitations to tree regeneration and growth remain unclear, but some studies have suggested that moisture limitations may be an important environmental factor.  Water relations in seedlings may be unique in high latitude sites due to continuous daylight during the growing season, which may create excessive demand for water even on sites with good water availability.  This study examined photosynthesis and water relations in spruce, pine and subalpine fir seedlings under conditions of continuous light in both field and controlled environments.
dct_title_s: Seedling photosynthetic and water-use efficiency under continuous daylight
